snippet.title: ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies - Steam Demo Live
snippet.description:
The ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies demo is now available as part of #SteamNextFest. 

Assume the role of burnt-out operant Hershel Wilk (alias: CASCADE) who has been awoken from desk-job purgatory to revisit the city-state of Portofiro and complete one final, desperate mission.

This demo encompasses the first few hours of ZERO PARADES gameplay, giving players a taste of our grand spy RPG, set to release later this year. 

After years of meticulous development and ideation, we’re beyond excited for you to experience this labour of love. Play now: https://tr.ee/nextfestannounce
